attributes.name: War Drum
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to add 1d4 to a combat check by a character at your location. Each character at your location may discard an ally; for each ally discarded, add 1d4 to that check.

If you have the Warpriest trait, recharge this card to draw a weapon from your discard pile.
